items.title: DOJ opens antitrust probe into Nvidia's ~$20B licensing deal with AI chip startup Groq
items.summary: The US Justice Department sent Nvidia a formal information request, investigating whether its ~$20 billion non-exclusive IP license with Groq — which also included hiring several Groq executives including founder Jonathan Ross — was structured to sidestep HSR merger-notification thresholds. Nvidia calls the deal 'a prime example of the American system working as designed.'
items.why: 英伟达面临DOJ反垄断调查，短期监管不确定性上升；持有NVDA仓位需警惕监管利空冲击，Sell Put行权价应适当下移，留出更多保护空间。

items.title: Apple unveils iPhone Duo foldable ($1,999) and iPhone 18 Pro lineup in CEO John Ternus's debut keynote
items.summary: At the 'Surprise and Shine' event on Sept. 9, Apple revealed the iPhone Duo — its first foldable with a 7.6-inch unfolded display — starting at $1,999, alongside iPhone 18 Pro/Max, AirPods 5, and Watch Series 12. The same week saw Xiaomi's 18 Fold (CNY 10,999) and Huawei's Mate XT2 trifold (CNY 19,999), marking the most concentrated foldable device-release week in history.
items.why: 折叠屏手机超级发布周，行业级事件催化；苹果首款折叠机重塑高端折叠市场竞争格局，直接影响小米1810.HK高端份额预期，关注出货数据对股价催化。

items.title: 金融强国建设十五五规划正式出台，明确2030年形成现代金融体系框架目标
items.summary: 国务院新闻办9月10日发布《金融强国建设十五五规划》，目标2030年基本形成中国特色现代金融体系框架、2035年基本建立；九大行动计划覆盖宏调体系完善、金融监管强化、风险防化、实体经济服务及对外开放扩大。证监会同步介绍贯彻落实情况。
items.why: 顶层政策出台，利好资本市场中长期稳定预期，直接提振金融板块；为港A两市互联网、消费龙头提供良好政策背景，与持仓赛道方向一致。

items.title: Palantir AIPCon 11: NVIDIA and Palantir launch sovereign AI stack for supply chains; FAA, Cisco, L3Harris among customers
items.summary: At AIPCon 11 on Sept. 10, Palantir and NVIDIA unveiled a joint enterprise AI stack combining Palantir's Ontology/AIP platform with NVIDIA Nemotron open models, first deployed in NVIDIA's own supply chain. Deployment options include on-prem with Cisco/Dell or cloud with Rackspace/Nebius. Customers including the FAA, Acrisure, L3Harris, and Zeta Global showcased live use cases.
items.why: Palantir PLTR政府+企业AI合同持续放量，与英伟达深度绑定增强护城河；PLTR近月期权隐含波动率异常高（9月18日到期Call仓位过重），Sell Put空间有限，需保持较宽价外距离。

items.title: 小米18 Fold折叠屏（10999元起）与华为Mate XT2三折叠（19999元起）同日发布，苹果同周推出$1999折叠机正面竞争
items.summary: 9月7日，小米发布折叠屏旗舰小米18 Fold（中折叠设计，搭载骁龙8E6+玄戒O3），起售价10999元；华为同日发布第二代三折叠Mate XT2非凡大师，起售价19999元。苹果随后于9月9日推出iPhone Duo（$1,999/约14400元），9月折叠屏三强竞争格局确立。
items.why: 延续报道：小米/华为/苹果折叠屏三机同周，市场讨论持续。小米1810.HK折叠屏旗舰产品周期启动，竞争加剧；折叠机密集发布季可能推升小米期权隐含波动率，Covered Call机会可关注。

items.title: Asian stocks rally as traders pare Fed-hike bets ahead of US jobs data
items.summary: Asian benchmarks rose broadly on Friday: Hong Kong's Hang Seng climbed 2.2% to 25,765, Japan's Nikkei gained 1.3%, and Seoul/Singapore/Taipei all rose over 1%. The rally followed Fed Governor Waller's signals of a September rate hold; markets now await August U.S. non-farm payrolls due later today.
items.why: 美联储9月按兵不动预期进一步升温，推动港股恒指大涨2.2%至25765点，科技股领涨亚太；对持有港股仓位（sell put策略）形成阶段性支撑，非农数据今晚是下一关键催化剂

items.title: Fresh US-Iran strikes send oil surging past $90 WTI, $95 Brent; yields jump
items.summary: U.S. and Iranian forces exchanged fresh strikes, renewing fears of prolonged Strait of Hormuz disruption — through which over 20% of global oil trade flows. WTI settled above $90/bbl and Brent topped $95 for the first time since late July, marking oil's biggest weekly gain since July; Treasury yields spiked before pulling back.
items.why: 美伊战争再度升级是本轮最大地缘风险，油价飙升推高通胀预期，叠加美联储决策不确定性；亚太能源股受益，但整体市场波动率抬升对期权卖方需谨慎管理仓位

items.title: Fed Governor Waller indicates he will support holding rates steady at September meeting
items.summary: 美联储理事沃勒9月3日发出鸽派信号：若通胀数据无意外，支持9月FOMC维持利率不变。市场对9月加息押注骤降约12个百分点，2年期美债收益率下行3bp至4.34%。
items.why: 利率路径直接影响全球估值与期权隐含波动率；sell put 策略在加息预期降温时通常受益于IV回落，权利金压缩风险降低。

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P Live Updates for September 4
items.summary: 9月3日美股大涨：标普500 +1.06%报7747.71点，纳指 +1.4%报26584.06点，道指升624点（+1.18%）报53686点。沃勒鸽派表态叠加英伟达大型并购消息双重提振，港股ADR跟涨，亚股料追升。
items.why: 美股全面反弹改善全球风险偏好，港股ADR做好，持仓组合整体受益；大盘大涨后隐含波动率通常有所压缩，卖put权利金需重新评估时机。

items.title: Nvidia Agrees to $13 Billion Deal for AI Platform Hugging Face
items.summary: 英伟达正式确认以约130亿美元收购AI开源平台Hugging Face，并附约10亿美元员工留任奖励包。英伟达承诺维持平台开放性。受此消息提振，NVDA盘后涨约1.8%。
items.why: 年度最大AI并购交易，英伟达锁定AI模型开源生态主导权，进一步巩固其在AI产业链的定价权；并购消息往往推升相关期权隐含波动率。

items.title: Google Avoids Breakup as Judge Orders Ad Tech Unit Changes
items.summary: 美国联邦法官裁定谷歌无需出售广告交易平台AdX，改要求广告技术工具与竞争对手实现互操作性。Alphabet由此避免被强制拆分，广告业务（占营收主体）经营连续性获保障。
items.why: 裁定消除Alphabet最大监管尾部风险，广告收入基本盘无虞；对持有GOOGL者，可关注股价反弹后卖covered call机会。

items.title: US August Jobs Shock: Payrolls Rise 162K vs 53K Forecast; Yields Hit 18-Month High
items.summary: August nonfarm payrolls came in at 162,000, nearly 3x the 53,000 consensus, the strongest monthly gain since March. July was revised to +21,000 from -23,000. Unemployment held at 4.1%. The 2-year Treasury yield surged to its highest since January 2025. US stocks fell: S&P 500 -0.38%, Dow -0.51%, Nasdaq -0.29%.
items.why: 非农数据大幅超预期是本周最重磅宏观冲击，美债短端收益率飙升，美股高估值成长股估值承压；对 sell put 策略而言，波动率上升、行权价安全边际收窄，需重新审视各持仓期权的 delta 风险。

items.title: Fed September Rate Hike Odds Near 50% After Jobs Beat; CPI on Sept. 11 Is the Decider
items.summary: Futures markets lifted the probability of a Fed rate hike at the Sept. 15–16 FOMC meeting to roughly 50% following the August jobs beat. The Fed has held rates at 3.5%–3.75% for five consecutive meetings; three FOMC members had already dissented, preferring +25 bps. September CPI (due Sept. 11) is now the pivotal data point.
items.why: 美联储9月加息概率升至约50%，直接影响美元资产估值和港股流动性；CPI是下周最关键变量——若通胀回落缓慢，加息将对高倍市盈率持仓（如PLTR、NVDA）形成进一步估值压力，卖出期权策略的隐含波动率值得重点跟踪。

items.title: 胡塞武装袭击沙特阿美设施，Brent原油触99.22美元/桶，油价9月涨幅逾8%
items.summary: 伊朗盟友胡塞武装对沙特阿美及多处炼厂发动无人机与弹道导弹攻击，沙特能源部宣布部分油田及贾赞400万桶/日炼厂暂停运营。Brent原油最高触及99.22美元/桶，WTI达94.60美元/桶，9月累计涨逾8%。
items.why: 油价逼近100美元直接推高通胀预期，美联储9月18-19日会议加息概率随之升至约60%；能源成本上行压缩消费/零售板块利润，港美股整体情绪承压；持有高估值科技/消费个股的 sell put 头寸需关注隐含波动率扩张风险。

items.title: 美联储9/18-19会议加息概率升至60%，特朗普全力施压Warsh暂缓
items.summary: 美联储内部鹰鸽分歧激化：上次会议9比3投票维持3.5%-3.75%利率不变，3位异见委员明确要求加息。最新数据显示，加息25bp概率已升至约60%；特朗普、副总统、财长等同步公开施压Fed主席Warsh暂缓行动。9月8日油价飙升进一步强化通胀上行预期。
items.why: 若9/18加息落地，港股/美股整体估值承压，高PE科技与消费股跌幅往往领先；卖出期权的隐含波动率在会议前一周通常走阔，是调整 sell put 行权价的时间窗口；应提前评估现有仓位的利率敏感度。

items.title: Brent Crude Tops $101/bbl as US-Iran War Escalates at Strait of Hormuz; Iran Vows 'More Intense' Conflict
items.summary: Brent crude held above $101.84 a barrel (up ~9% in five days) as the US struck Iranian oil tankers and Iran threatened a broader war in the Strait of Hormuz. The strait channels ~20% of global oil supply; the IEA has characterized the disruption as the largest in global oil market history.
items.why: 油价破百推高通胀预期，强化美联储加息立场；对持仓而言，海底捞、美团等餐饮类承受成本端双重压力（食材+配送能源成本上涨），消费类港股估值亦面临压制；期权隐含波动率上升，短期卖出期权需谨慎。

items.title: August 2026 jobs report today: only 53K payrolls forecast amid 'jobless summer'
items.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the August jobs report Friday, September 4 at 8:30 AM ET; consensus forecasts call for just 53,000 new nonfarm payrolls after the prior two months showed a net loss of 3,000 jobs, potentially reinforcing the Fed's case to hold rates in September.
items.why: 弱非农数据将进一步压低美联储9月加息概率，利好风险资产和港股；若数据大幅低于预期，市场有望延续本周升势，期权卖方（sell put）策略短期处于有利环境

items.title: Costco August 2026 net sales $23.70B, up 9.9%; FY2026 full-year sales $297.3B
items.summary: Costco reported August 2026 net sales of $23.70 billion (+9.9% YoY), with comparable sales up 8.4% (U.S. +9.0%, Canada +4.0%, international +9.5%) and e-commerce surging 17.9%; FY2026 full-year net sales reached $297.3 billion (+10.2%), closing in on $300B.
items.why: 好市多销售数据持续超预期，会员消费韧性强；FY2026全年接近3000亿美元是重要里程碑，Q4季报定于9月24日，期权到期前有催化剂窗口值得关注

items.title: Xiaomi makes historic IFA 2026 debut: CyberOne humanoid on factory floors, in-house XRING AI chip, EV European push
items.summary: Xiaomi debuted at IFA 2026 in Berlin with its largest overseas booth (3,300 sqm, 380+ products) under the 'Human × Car × Home' theme, showcasing CyberOne humanoid robot deployed on EV assembly lines with 98% task success rate, the new XRING O3 3nm AI chip, and signed deals with German EV dealers targeting a 2027 European launch with €7.4B R&D commitment.
items.why: 小米IFA首秀是品牌出海战略破圈关键里程碑：汽车拟2027年入欧洲、机器人量产验证、自研芯片齐推；多重叙事共振有望推动1810.HK估值重估，IFA媒体曝光度达历史新高

items.title: Meituan's Keeta faces Brazil antitrust deepened probe after iFood complaint over predatory pricing
items.summary: Brazil's CADE ordered a deepened antitrust investigation into Meituan-backed Keeta after local rival iFood (Prosus) filed a formal complaint alleging predatory pricing — Keeta offers up to 250 reais per order and subsidizes up to 80% per transaction — and requested a preliminary injunction to halt below-cost operations.
items.why: 延续报道：CADE已命令展开更深层次审查，事件持续发酵。巴西监管若发出禁令可能实质阻碍Keeta扩张，美团3690.HK国际化叙事受压；持有美团仓位需持续跟踪巴西监管进展

items.title: Snowflake (SNOW) Q2 earnings report 2027
items.summary: Snowflake发布Q2 FY2027财报（截至2026年7月31日），产品收入15.5亿美元超预期14.8亿美元，同比增35%；调整后EPS 0.62美元大超预期0.45美元；Q3指引强劲，股价盘后大涨逾20%。
items.why: Snowflake大幅超预期印证企业AI数据云需求持续强劲，是科技/AI板块情绪转暖的重要信号；AI基础设施需求加速支撑英伟达、美光等持仓逻辑。

items.title: A股突变高开低走：科创50跌超2%，猪肉板块逆势涨停；厄尔尼诺超强事件确认
items.summary: 9月4日A股高开后全线回落，沪指跌0.3%，深成指跌0.79%，科创50指数跌超2.1%。世界气象组织发布公报确认厄尔尼诺事件已出现并预计增强为超强事件，猪肉、生猪养殖板块逆市大涨，多股涨停。
items.why: A股科技板块回调、科创50领跌，A股科技持仓短期承压；厄尔尼诺超强确认引发粮食与农业板块阶段性炒作，与消费/科技持仓关联有限但反映市场情绪分化；需关注隔夜美股下跌对次日A股开盘的传导。

items.title: 港股恒生指数9月8日连跌0.5%至25,283点，投资者待中国8月贸易数据
items.summary: 恒生指数9月8日下跌约0.5%收报25,283点，连续第二日走弱，主因油价飙升加剧通胀担忧，市场同时等待中国8月贸易数据以评估经济复苏节奏。
items.why: 恒指连跌两日，港股整体情绪偏弱；贸易数据若低于预期将进一步压制消费/出口相关个股；对持有港股 sell put 仓位而言，需关注行权价保护垫是否充足。

items.title: 月之暗面Moonshot AI机密申请港交所IPO，拟融资30-50亿美元，估值500亿美元
items.summary: Kimi大模型母公司月之暗面已机密提交港股上市申请，计划于9月底前递交正式招股书，最快今年底或2027年Q1挂牌。此次IPO拟融资30-50亿美元，当前融资轮估值约500亿美元。花旗、高盛、德银、中金为联席保荐人，美国银行担任整体协调人。
items.why: 中国头部AI独角兽赴港IPO提振港股科技板块情绪，有利于恒生科技指数相关持仓；500亿美元估值创大模型赛道新高，可能带动市场重估同类型AI/互联网平台（腾讯、阿里、美团等）的AI价值；后续IPO进展将影响港股科技板块整体流动性。

items.title: Circle (CRCL) 签约约4亿美元收购新加坡B2B支付平台Tazapay
items.summary: Circle签署协议以约4亿美元股票对价收购新加坡跨境支付平台Tazapay，后者年化支付量逾250亿美元，约60%交易量已含稳定币。此次收购将为USDC增加60家银行/金融科技合作伙伴及逾100个市场的本地出金能力，交割预计2027年完成（需新加坡MAS批准）。
items.why: Circle以股票收购Tazapay直接扩大USDC在亚太及新兴市场的支付基础设施，强化GENIUS Act实施后的护城河；收购消息落地，关注CRCL股价短期隐含波动率的影响——4亿美元股票对价意味着一定稀释压力，可评估是否适合 sell call 策略。

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab商业上路当日遭NHTSA审查，股价跌6%
items.summary: 特斯拉9月3日在奥斯汀启动首批Cybercab商业运营（约1000辆，无方向盘/踏板），NHTSA次日即宣布对Cybercab的FMVSS安全认证程序展开审查，质疑Tesla自我认证合规性。发布会CEO马斯克缺席，活动仅对小范围股东和网红保密举行，华尔街普遍认为「不达预期」，特斯拉股价单日跌6%至约352美元。
items.why: NHTSA审查若升级为正式调查，可能推迟Cybercab大规模部署（原计划2026年铺开1万辆），对特斯拉FSD/Robotaxi估值逻辑直接构成压制；TSLA股价近期震荡，隐含波动率偏高，持有TSLA sell put需密切跟踪监管进展，调整行权价或及时平仓。

items.title: Gold Steadies Near $4,400 as Traders Weigh Fed Rate-Hike Path
items.summary: Gold hovered near $4,400/oz, supported by safe-haven demand amid Middle East tensions while hawkish Fed rate-hike expectations and rising Treasury yields capped upside. The metal faces conflicting pressures ahead of the September 16 FOMC meeting, where markets price a ~57% probability of a 25bps rate hike to 3.75–4.0%. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh described financial conditions as 'not broadly restrictive' and flagged PCE at 3.7% YoY as a concern.
items.why: 黄金逼近4400美元/盎司为年内高位，与美联储9月加息预期及中东地缘风险形成张力；距今2天内仍在演变（9月16日FOMC会议将是关键催化剂），still_developing=true。Bloomberg白名单媒体。

items.title: 燧原科技688801今日登陆科创板：发行价142.18元，募资近60亿元
items.summary: 燧原科技（688801.SH）于2026年9月11日正式登陆上交所科创板，发行价142.18元/股，总募资约60亿元人民币，为本月A股最大规模科创板IPO。公司主营面向AI训练/推理的国产GPU/NPU芯片，定位国内替代英伟达产品的高端算力赛道。首日交易数据尚未完整披露，上市后涨幅待观察。
items.why: 今日（9月11日）为燧原科技上市首日，属于正在发生中的市场事件；发行价及募资规模已由第一财经（白名单媒体）于9月9日报道，首日实际走势仍在演变中，still_developing=true。国产AI芯片赛道高度关注。

items.title: Global Risk-Off: Hang Seng Falls ~300pts, Wall Street 3-Day Decline, US 10-Year Treasury at 4.86% (Highest Since Nov 2023)
items.summary: Surging oil prices and mounting Fed rate-hike bets triggered a broad global selloff on September 10: the Hang Seng Index fell ~300 points to around 24,970; US 10-year Treasury yields climbed to 4.86%; and Wall Street stocks extended losses into a third consecutive session.
items.why: 港股和美股同步承压——组合中的港股持仓（腾讯、泡泡玛特、美团、老铺黄金）短期均面临估值收缩压力；美债利率快速上行亦直接抬升期权定价的无风险利率基础，Sell Put总体吸引力暂降，宜评估各标的margin要求。

items.title: Xi-Trump Washington Summit Confirmed for Sept 24; US-China Negotiate Tariff Cuts on $30B of Goods 'at an Early Date'
items.summary: US and Chinese negotiators are striving for reciprocal tariff reductions on $30 billion of 'nonsensitive' goods ahead of Xi Jinping's confirmed Washington visit on September 24—their third face-to-face this year. The tariff truce expires November 10; the US is simultaneously eyeing a new 7.5% overcapacity tariff on Chinese exports before the summit.
items.why: 中美峰会在即，若谈判顺利达成关税减让，将正面提振中概股、港股整体估值；阿里巴巴（淘天跨境/国际）、拼多多（Temu出海）受益最直接；同时需警惕美国7.5%产能税落地的负面冲击，尤其影响电动车、消费电子相关板块。

items.title: Disney CFO at Goldman Sachs Communacopia (Sept 9): Streaming Hits 13% Operating Margins, Q3 DTC Income Doubled
items.summary: At the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 9, Disney CFO Hugh Johnston highlighted streaming profitability: Disney+ reached 13% operating margins in Q3; direct-to-consumer operating income more than doubled to $712M YoY. Management guided for 12% underlying EPS growth this fiscal year and flagged a shift from cost-cutting to a revenue-growth story.
items.why: Disney流媒体盈利拐点明确，商业模式可持续性增强；对DIS持仓者，12%的EPS增速目标支持Covered Call上移行权价；流媒体广告层（如有）还可带来额外收入，需关注Q4订阅增长数据确认趋势。

items.title: SanDisk CEO at Goldman Sachs Communacopia (Sept 9): Data Centers Now >50% of NAND Market; FY2028 Supply Largely Locked In
items.summary: SanDisk CEO David Goeckeler told Goldman Sachs Communacopia attendees on Sept 9 that AI-driven data center demand has crossed 50% of total NAND market for the first time—a structural watershed. SanDisk has signed 8 long-term data center supply agreements in the past 9 months and locked ~2/3 of FY2028 bit supply. Management reiterated FY2028–2030 targets: mid-to-high teens revenue growth, ~80% gross margins, ~70% operating margins.
items.why: AI数据中心存储需求结构性验证，供应端确定性高（FY28约2/3供应已预售），高毛利目标（80%毛利率）业绩可见度强；SanDisk与美光（Micron）、SK海力士同处存储超级周期，适合维持Sell Put策略捕获期权收益。
